events.title: The Third Battle of Panipat
events.description: In northern India, the Afghan Durrani Empire under Ahmad Shah Durrani faced the Maratha Empire under Sadashivrao Bhau. It was the largest battle of the 18th century.
events.significance: The battle badly weakened Maratha power in northern India. It reshaped the region's political landscape in the decades before British dominance.

events.title: Congress Ratifies the Treaty of Paris
events.description: The Confederation Congress ratified the Treaty of Paris with Great Britain. The treaty formally ended the American Revolutionary War.
events.significance: The ratification confirmed British recognition of American independence. It is still commemorated in the United States as Ratification Day.

events.title: Napoleon Wins at Rivoli
events.description: Napoleon Bonaparte won a decisive victory at the Battle of Rivoli in northern Italy. The win came during the War of the First Coalition.
events.significance: The victory marked the beginning of the end of the First Coalition. It paved the way for French dominance over Italy for about two decades.

events.title: Puccini's Tosca Premieres in Rome
events.description: Giacomo Puccini's opera Tosca opened in Rome. It is a tale of love, political intrigue and tragedy.
events.significance: Tosca became one of the most frequently performed operas in the world. It remains a cornerstone of the standard repertoire.

events.title: Earthquake Devastates Kingston, Jamaica
events.description: A powerful earthquake struck Kingston, Jamaica, killing more than 1,000 people.
events.significance: It was one of the deadliest natural disasters in the Caribbean's early modern history. It forced a major rebuilding of the capital.
